recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If a future versioned canonical redirect fails, track it against publisher/live-site redirect configuration rather than adding redundant author-facing prose or inactive redirects to core source.
issue_request: Applied FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking that versioned canonical URLs such as [url]|[version] resolve through redirects. The accepted resolution was for Grahame to set up version-specific redirects in the live spec as a publishing task, not an author opt-in/source requirement.
initial_application: No source commit tagged with FHIR-21652 was found, and current build inputs do not contain an author-facing redirect rule for this behavior. The application appears to have happened in publisher/live hosting infrastructure, corroborated by FHIR-I minutes and by live hl7.org redirect behavior.
additional_context: Current source documents canonical [url]|[version] references and publish.ini has only unrelated static canonicalization redirects. Jira/community searches found no later final FHIR-core decision requiring a source edit; Confluence confirms the approved work was to set redirects during publisher.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. The requested behavior is observable on hl7.org for tested published core versions, while the implementation lives outside this FHIR source checkout/current build inputs.
